title: Read a file
description: Read a text file line by line using BufferedReader and print each line.
hints: Read each line with br.readLine() in a while loop
Close the BufferedReader in a finally block or with try-with-resources
solutionExplanation: BufferedReader wraps FileReader and offers readLine() to read each line. try-with-resources automatically closes the resource.
expectedOutput: [Contents of the datos.txt file, line by line]

title: Count lines and words
description: Read a text file and count the total number of lines and words it contains.
hints: Each readLine() is a new line, increment the line counter
Empty lines must be handled correctly
solutionExplanation: A counter is incremented for each line read. Words are counted using split() with whitespace as the delimiter.

title: Copy a file
description: Copy a complete file line by line to another file, also showing the progress.
hints: Use BufferedReader to read and BufferedWriter to write
Print the number of the copied line while you work
solutionExplanation: Both files are opened with try-with-resources. Each line from the source is read, written to the destination with bw.write(), and a new line is added with bw.newLine().
expectedOutput:
Line 1 copied: Hola mundo
Line 2 copied: Esta es una prueba
Line 3 copied: Copia exitosa
File copied: 3 lines
